name: Neural Harmonic Textures (2D Image Reconstruction Adaptation)
definition: An adaptation of Neural Harmonic Textures for 2D image fitting that replaces 3D primitives with a connected 2D triangle mesh and modifies the interpolation scheme to eliminate high-frequency artifacts.
summary: Neural Harmonic Textures adapts 2D image fitting by using a connected triangle mesh and Clough-Tocher cubic interpolation to eliminate high-frequency artifacts and alpha blending.
